description.plain:
The RATEFPV S30 Pro Frame is a upgraded, versatile 2.5/3-inch FPV frame designed for pilots—blending flexible compatibility, optimized build space, and sub-250g compliance. With a CNC-machined front nose, dual prop options, and broad support for popular flight stacks, cameras, and transmitters, it’s perfect for both cinematic filming and aggressive freestyle. Lightweight yet durable, it balances portability and performance, making it ideal for beginners and seasoned pilots alike—all at RATEFPV’s signature unbeatable value.

Key Features 

📐 Optimized Build Space: Redesigned internal layout for easier installation, no cramped wiring, and smooth assembly—saves time for DIY builds.
🛠️ CNC-Machined Front Nose: Compatible with nearly all FPV cameras; includes a new 3D-printable GPS mount for long-range setups (sold separately).
🚁 Dual Prop Options: 2.5-inch props for unobstructed footage (stable outdoor filming); 3-inch props for high agility (perfect for freestyle).
⚖️ Sub-250g Compliant: Total weight under 250g when fully built—meets most US/EU regulations, no registration hassle.
💪 Durable Carbon Fiber Construction: 3.5mm arm thickness, 2mm top/bottom plates, 1.5mm middle plate—crash-resistant for daily freestyle and practice.
🔧 Wide Compatibility: Works with most stacks, motors, and vtxs for maximum flexibility.

Specifications 

Wheelbase
  
2.5-inch: 122mm; 3-inch: 134mm
Plate Thicknes
Top/Bottom: 2mm; Middle: 1.5mm
Arm Thickness
3.5mm

O3/Vista and 25.5mm/20mm analog vtxs

9mm-12mm hole spacing motors

Cinematic: 2.5-inch (HG2.5x2.5x3+, pitch ≥25); Freestyle: 3-inch (HG3x2.5x3, HG3x3x3+, pitch ≥25)

DeepSpace SEEKER 3 / 3 inch FPV freestyle Frame Kit for DJI O4 PRO O3 AIR UNIT

The DeepSpace SEEKER 3 Frame Kit is a premium 3-inch FPV freestyle frame engineered for high-performance drone builds. Designed to support both DJI O4 PRO and O3 Air Units, this frame provides ideal mounting options and airflow for modern digital video systems while maintaining a lightweight, freestyle-ready design.

Crafted for balance, durability, and agility, the DeepSpace SEEKER 3 Frame Kit features a robust carbon fiber construction with a forward GPS mount, optimized for satellite reception and minimal interference. With a sub-250g target weight (when fully built), it’s perfect for cinematic and freestyle pilots looking to maximize flight time and responsiveness in a compact footprint.

Compatible with 20×20mm and 25.5×25.5mm stack mounting options, the frame offers excellent flexibility for a range of flight controllers, ESCs, and VTX systems.

Key Features:

  • Designed for DJI O4 PRO and O3 Air Units

  • 3-inch freestyle layout – agile, responsive, and durable

  • Sub-250g build target with recommended components

  • Forward-mounted GPS tray for optimal signal clarity

  • Compatible with 20×20mm and 25.5×25.5mm stacks

  • Lightweight carbon fiber arms and plates

description.plain:
Crash-Proof Your 3" Build — Without the Weight Penalty

Every FPV pilot knows the feeling: one bad landing, and your flight controller or camera is gone. The RATEFPV Snap 30 is built so that never happens to your 3-inch build. A fully enclosed, injection-molded shell wraps your electronics on every side — so when you crash, the frame takes the hit, not your circuit board.

Full-body injection-molded protection. The entire airframe is sheathed in a tough molded shell — not just prop guards, but real coverage around your stack and camera. Your sensitive electronics stay intact through the crashes that end most builds.

High-strength T700 carbon fiber core. The structural plates use T700 — the same aerospace-grade carbon favored for its higher tensile strength over standard T300 frames. You get a frame that shrugs off harder hits while staying light enough to punch out and rip freestyle.

Lighter frame, longer flights, snappier moves. Strength without ballast means more efficiency per battery and crisper response in the air. The protection you want, without the sluggish feel enclosed frames usually bring.

4-screw quick-release. See everything in seconds. Need to check wiring, swap a part, or just show a friend your build? Loosen the four screws on the bottom plate and the whole internals are exposed — no full teardown, no lost screws, no swearing. Assembly and field repairs become genuinely easy.

Why Choose a Protected Frame?

An open carbon frame is lighter by a few grams — until a crash smashes a $40 flight controller or a $30 camera. The Snap 30 pays for itself the first time you bounce off a wall instead of rebuilding. You fly harder, closer, and near people or property with confidence — the ducted shell keeps props away from what matters.

T700 carbon fiber core: Delivers high strength and lightweight performance for efficient flight

Ducted prop protection: Keeps propellers away from sensitive electronics to prevent damage
Enclosed design: Maintains snappy response and efficiency while providing robust protection

description.plain:
“A balance of size, budget, and fun-factor, that encourages anyone to create awesome HD FPV videos, without risking expensive equipment, breaking laws, or scaring spectators.” – Tommy

Check out www.acrobrat.com for a full story of the how and why the Acrobrat was designed.

This is THE frame that jump started the Micro HD/low cost HD craze.

 

Design Goals:

  1. A well designed 3” quad that feels and flies like a 5”
  2. Uses the runcam split mini (or caddx Turtle), that mitigates the jello issues that these HD cams can be prone to.
  3. All in a package that is fairly durable and not intimidating for the pilot or spectators
Specs:
  • Unibody Main plate = 3mm bi-axial Toray Carbon Fiber
  • Side plates (w/adjustable FPV cam placement) = 2mm bi-axial Toray Carbon Fiber
  • Battery plate (w/optional top mount FC holes) = 1.5mm bi-axial Toray Carbon Fiber
  • Hardware = Stainless Steel
  • Frame Dampeners = Custom Poly-urethane
  • Motor to Motor (diagonal) = 163mm
  • Motor to Motor (front to back/side to side) = 115mm
  • Overall Frame size = 141x141mm
  • Frame height = 55.5mm
  • Dry Frame Weight = 54g
  • Motor bolt pattern = 12x12mm
  • Motor c-clip hole = 6mm

top_features: Unibody main plate with 3mm bi axial Toray carbon fiber side plates for enhanced strength and stability
Adjustable FPV camera placement for optimal camera positioning during flight
Custom poly urethane dampeners reduce vibration for smoother video feed
Stainless steel hardware ensures long-lasting durability
Compatible with popular micro HD FPV cameras like Runcam Split Mini and Caddx Turtle
unique_selling_points: Combines a lightweight, robust build with a custom FPV camera mount to enable high-definition FPV flying at an accessible price.

description.plain:
This frame is cut from really nice carbon.


Low weight, excellent balance, easy to use, easy to service, respectable component protection, and DJI Vista ready. These were the goals of the Tooth Fairy 2. The low weight of this design will satisfy those 250g builds but it's really designed to handle ~325g AUW 5" to 5.21" build. Of course you can always run past that weight like we do so it's really up to you. We regularly carry GoPro's on our builds.

The most unique feature of this frame is that the Vista is integrated into the structure. The entire rear standoff is the Vista. Also, the 3" is designed with the option to use these prop guards if desired.

Light frames suffer from vibrational noise and resonance.  These complications get worse as you increase the power of the quad.  In order to improve reliability of these matters, this design has a unique vibration management arm mounting mechanism pointed out by Chris Rosser (YouTube: Chris Rosser).  The mechanism introduces friction without the loss of rigidity.  As a result, the 4mm arm version of this frame will be able to handle more powerful motors than it should.  However because the frame does have somewhat long skinny arms, the 5mm version is STRONGLY recommended to use for any build that has motors larger than 2303 or otherwise 23mm short motors.  The 5mm version should be selected for use with our 23mm tall motors.

Furthermore, there is an optional included carbon shim for ease of use with damping grease.  This shim is intended to be used with Nyogel 767a, Nyogel pg-44A or some other vibration damping grease (or tape if you wish). The point is to put the grease between the shim and the main deck so you can swap arms easily without dealing with gooey grease all over the arms. The included arm screws should fit with the shim and grease but they could be 1mm longer. You may want to acquire 12mm M2 screws if you wish. Future batches will include slightly longer screws.




Gopro and antenna mounts CLICK HERE

 Specifications of each version:

5" ToothFairy 2:

About vibration management options for any build:

Damping grease between frame joints and under motors has been shown to make a significant improvement in quad resonance management. The difference can be as significant as going from completely un-flyable mess to beautifully flyable. More commonly it's just a minor improvement and only if you're at least somewhat versed in tuning filters. To those that don't burden themselves with tuning, there may not be any benefit other than consistency of performance across several builds. Other damping options such as electrical tape, TPU or some other solid material are only sometimes helpful and only on some quad builds (YMMV). Damping grease will improve ALL quads resonance profile without exception. The difference is that grease is a liquid and tape or some other material is a solid. Solids have elasticity while liquids do not. In fact if electrical tape helps, it's the sticky liquid glue attached to the solid electrical tape that is doing the work. The solid component of the tape is making it worse because it has elasticity. Regardless, if you're looking for performance improvements, vibration management and reducing filters are the easiest way to go. At this point it is recommended to use some sort of damping grease on every build because of how significant the benefits can be. That being said, we will also be the first to point out that vibration management is not at all required the vast majority of the time because of the software management in all flight code today.

description.plain:
This frame is cut from really nice carbon.


Low weight, excellent balance, easy to use, easy to service, respectable component protection, and DJI Vista ready. These were the goals of the Tooth Fairy 2. The low weight of this design will satisfy those 250g builds but it's really designed to handle ~325g AUW 5" to 5.21" build. Of course you can always run past that weight like we do so it's really up to you. We regularly carry GoPro's on our builds.

The most unique feature of this frame is that the Vista is integrated into the structure. The entire rear standoff is the Vista. Also, the 3" is designed with the option to use these prop guards if desired.

Light frames suffer from vibrational noise and resonance.  These complications get worse as you increase the power of the quad.  In order to improve reliability of these matters, this design has a unique vibration management arm mounting mechanism pointed out by Chris Rosser (YouTube: Chris Rosser).  The mechanism introduces friction without the loss of rigidity.  As a result, the 4mm arm version of this frame will be able to handle more powerful motors than it should.  However because the frame does have somewhat long skinny arms, the 5mm version is STRONGLY recommended to use for any build that has motors larger than 2303 or otherwise 23mm short motors.  The 5mm version should be selected for use with our 23mm tall motors.

Furthermore, there is an optional included carbon shim for ease of use with damping grease.  This shim is intended to be used with Nyogel 767a, Nyogel pg-44A or some other vibration damping grease (or tape if you wish). The point is to put the grease between the shim and the main deck so you can swap arms easily without dealing with gooey grease all over the arms. The included arm screws should fit with the shim and grease but they could be 1mm longer. You may want to acquire 12mm M2 screws if you wish. Future batches will include slightly longer screws.

description.plain:
NewBeeDrone LionBee 3inch Frame

The NewBeeDrone LionBee Long Range Frame introduces a completely new structural concept designed specifically for 1S long-range FPV platforms. Unlike traditional micro-long-range frames, the LionBee Frame is engineered around a dedicated 18650 battery chamber, creating a rigid, optimized layout that enhances balance, reduces vibration, and increases endurance.

This frame was built to support the innovative LionBee AIO flight controller and its extended mounting architecture. With a unique 25.5 × 82mm FC mounting pattern, the LionBee Frame allows the AIO board to integrate directly with the battery chamber, forming a unified structural module that improves both electrical and mechanical performance.

Constructed from lightweight, high-strength carbon fiber, the LionBee Frame delivers stability and durability while maintaining the efficiency required for long-range missions. The stretched body layout provides smoother airflow and improved propeller efficiency, making it ideal for endurance flying, GPS-assisted missions, and ultra-light exploration builds.

With a modular, replaceable battery chamber design, field maintenance becomes simple and reliable—allowing fast swaps after impacts without requiring soldering. Combined with a clean top-mount component layout, the LionBee Frame is built for developers, explorers, and pilots who want to push 1S long-range performance into a new generation.

 

Key Features

  • Designed specifically for 1S long-range FPV builds

  • Structural integration with 18650 battery chamber

  • Supports the LionBee AIO FC with 25.5 × 82mm mounting pattern

  • Lightweight, high-strength carbon fiber construction

  • Stretched body layout for improved aerodynamic efficiency

  • Modular, replaceable 18650 battery chamber design

  • Optimized center-of-gravity placement for stable cruising

  • Compatible with M10Q GPS modules and long-range accessories

  • Clean top-mounted electronics layout for simplified wiring

  • Engineered for developers, innovators, and long-range explorers

 

 

Specifications

  • Frame Material: Carbon Fiber

  • Wheelbase: 3-inch class

  • FC Mounting Pattern: 25.5 × 82mm (LionBee AIO format)

  • Motor Mounting: 9mm / 1202 class motors

  • Battery Type: 1× 18650 Li-ion cell (JP30 recommended)

  • Battery Mounting: Integrated replaceable battery chamber

  • Antenna Mounting: Supports IPEX1, IPEX3, and TPU brackets

  • Camera Mounting: Micro-FPV camera compatible

  • Weight: Ultra-light optimized for endurance

 

What’s Included

  • 1× Carbon Fiber LionBee Frame Plate Set

  • 1× TPU Camera Mount

  • 1× TPU GPS Mount

  • Full Screw & Hardware Kit

  • Adhesive pads and mounting accessories
